### STEP 1 — Scene
A light Japanese/Vietnamese-style meal: four maki sushi pieces, two fresh rice-paper rolls, a small salad, and dipping condiments. I include the salad as part of the meal; water contributes no calories.

### STEP 2 — Vessels
- **Main plate:** approximately 23 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 11.5² = **415 cm²**.
- **Salad bowl:** approximately 20 cm diameter; projected area = **314 cm²**.
- **Condiment cups:** approximately 4 cm diameter each; area = **12.6 cm²** each.

### STEP 3 — Visible items
Maki with rice, seaweed, and mixed fillings; two rice-paper rolls with vegetable/noodle-like fillings; tomatoes, avocado and leafy greens; a light dressing sheen; soy sauce, pickled ginger and wasabi. Exact roll fillings and dressing composition are uncertain.

### STEPS 4–6 — Area, volume and weight
Percentages refer to each item's own vessel. Dressing overlaps the salad rather than adding separate coverage.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × typical height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Four maki pieces | 16% of main plate | 66 × 2.2 = 145 ml | 0.90 | 131 |
| Two rice-paper rolls | 22% of main plate | 91 × 2.5 = 228 ml | 0.85 | 194 |
| Tomato pieces | 21% of salad bowl | 66 × 1.6 = 106 ml | 0.60 | 64 |
| Avocado pieces | 10% of salad bowl | 31 × 1.5 = 47 ml | 0.65 | 31 |
| Leafy greens | 14% of salad bowl | 44 × 2.0 = 88 ml | 0.15 | 13 |
| Dressing | Overlapping salad | Thin coating, approximately 5 ml | 1.00 | 5 |
| Soy sauce | 90% of its cup | 11.3 × 1.6 = 18 ml | 1.00 | 18 |
| Pickled ginger | 70% of its cup | 8.8 × 2.0 = 18 ml | 0.65 | 12 |
| Wasabi | 30% of its cup | 3.8 × 1.3 = 5 ml | 1.00 | 5 |

**Coverage check:** main plate approximately **38%**, salad bowl approximately **45%**. Both have substantial visible empty rims.

### STEP 7 — Energy
| Item | kcal per 100 g | Estimated kcal |
|---|---:|---:|
| Maki sushi | 160 | 210 |
| Rice-paper rolls | 145 | 281 |
| Tomatoes | 18 | 12 |
| Avocado | 160 | 50 |
| Leafy greens | 20 | 3 |
| Oil-based dressing | 880 | 44 |
| Soy sauce | 53 | 10 |
| Pickled ginger | 60 | 7 |
| Wasabi paste | 290 | 15 |

### STEP 8 — Sanity check
The estimate is **473 g of food and condiments, approximately 630 kcal**. That is plausible for four sushi pieces, two substantial fresh rolls, and a modest salad. The greatest uncertainty is the rolls’ filling and the amount of dressing.
